metadata.purpose: Verify the composed end-to-end SkirtParent executor sequences the accepted planner, parent-transfer, smoothing-plan, and smoothing-apply phases without hiding phase outputs or continuing after a failed mutation phase.
acceptance: Fast-forward main and include workflow implementation commit bc9535e669270017380d500c826bf62a59823f5b or later.
Compile skirt_parent_workflow.py and tests/test_skinning_skirt_parent_workflow.py together with the composed phase modules.
Run tests.test_skinning_skirt_parent_workflow and require all 4 tests to pass, proving phase ordering, output preservation, normalize/option forwarding, validation, and stop-on-failure behavior.
